verdict.rationale: Asking whether a user can opt out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a payments platform with SDKs and a dashboard, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The cited items cover payments, API keys, fraud systems and analytics dashboards only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
